annotationName.description: The number of the overridden annotation.

modifications.description:
Map to store the modifications in parameter values. If a parameter has been removed, the value is stored as null.

For instance, an annotation change from
```
@nodejs(typeSystem=true, async=false)
```
to
```
@nodejs(typeSystem=false, retryable=true)
```
would be represented as:
```
{
  "typeSystem": BaseCustomizationAnalysis.Modification.make({ base: "true", override: "false" }),
  "async": BaseCustomizationAnalysis.Modification.make({ base: "false", override: null }),
  "retryable": BaseCustomizationAnalysis.Modification.make({ base: null, override: "true" }),
}
```

title: Type to structure the override information for annotations.
